song.title: Rise Up
song.style: English, glittering upbeat disco with four-on-the-floor kick, funky rhythm guitar, string stabs, bouncy bass and handclaps, warm friendly male lead vocal, joyful, 124 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Flour on my face and on the floor
Dough as flat as the day before
I looked away to check my phone
And burnt it black as any stone

[Chorus]
Rise up, rise up, dough
Warm and golden, nice and slow
Rise up, rise up, high
Bread as big as the sky

[Verse]
My phone went sleeping on the door
I kneaded dough and nothing more
It puffed up round and warm and tall
Enough to feed us one and all

[Chorus]
Rise up, rise up, neighbours
Break the bread and taste the flavours
Rise up, rise up, high
Bread as big as the sky

shots.prompt: {moss} sneezes into a big bowl of flour and a huge white cloud bursts all over him, covering his glasses and mustache. The camera crash zooms in. Warm kitchen light.
Extreme close-up: {moss} blinks through flour-covered glasses, only his rosy cheeks showing. The camera pushes in. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} pokes a flat sad loaf of bread on the counter and it deflates with a puff. Top-down, the camera crash zooms in. Warm kitchen light.
A flat loaf slides off a baking tray like a frisbee and {moss} catches it. The camera whip pans with it. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} kneads dough with one hand while staring at a glowing phone in the other, the dough sagging off the counter. The camera orbits fast around him. Warm kitchen light.
Grey smoke curls out of an old green oven door. The camera pushes in fast. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} pulls a charred black loaf out of the oven in a puff of smoke, coughing. The camera crash zooms in. Warm kitchen light through smoke.
A charred black loaf drops onto a plate with a heavy clunk like a stone. Extreme close-up, low angle, the camera shakes. Warm kitchen light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, flour on his face, a mirror disco ball spinning above the kitchen. The camera pushes in. Warm sparkly light.
A mirror disco ball spins above a cosy kitchen, scattering warm spots of light. The camera spins under it. Warm sparkly light.
{moss} dances around the kitchen with a big bowl of dough in his arms like a dance partner. The camera orbits fast. Warm sparkly light.
A soft ball of dough wobbles in a bowl as if it is dancing. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} strikes a disco pose with one arm pointing to the ceiling. Low angle, the camera cranes up. Warm sparkly light.
{moss} looks from the glowing phone in his hand to the fridge across the kitchen. The camera whip pans to the fridge. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} gazes out of his kitchen window at a huge fluffy cloud shaped exactly like a round loaf of bread. The camera pushes past him toward the cloud. Bright blue sky.
{moss} marches across his kitchen toward the fridge with determination. The camera tracks with him. Warm morning light.

A black smartphone stands upright, face to the door, in a quilted moss-green brick stuck to a cream fridge door, a round sun-yellow badge with a closed eye on its front, a small shopping list held by a yellow magnet beside it. Soft leaf shadows sway slowly across the fridge door. Warm morning light. The camera pushes in slowly.
{moss} rolls up his raincoat sleeves and cracks his knuckles at the counter. The camera crash zooms in. Warm morning light.
{moss} kneads a big ball of dough with both hands, pushing and folding, flour puffing up. Top-down, the camera orbits. Warm morning light.
{moss} covers a bowl of dough with a striped tea towel and pats it gently. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm morning light.
A striped tea towel slowly lifts up as the dough beneath swells into a huge round dome. The camera pushes in fast. Warm morning light.
Extreme close-up: the jaw of {moss} drops under his mustache, his eyes wide behind his glasses. The camera crash zooms in. Warm morning light.
{moss} pulls a giant golden round loaf bigger than his whole body out of the oven. Low angle, the camera cranes up. Warm golden light.
Steam rises from a golden crust as chunky clay hands tear the loaf open. Extreme close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm golden light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, hugging a giant golden loaf in the doorway of his building. The camera pulls back. Warm golden light.
A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses sniffs the air from her open window and smiles. The camera pushes in. Warm golden light.

{moss} hands thick slices of bread to a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses and a little boy in green dungarees with curly black hair at a long table on the front stoop. The camera whip pans along the table. Warm afternoon sun.
A little boy in green dungarees with curly black hair takes a huge bite of bread, crumbs flying, grinning. Close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Warm afternoon sun.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, dancing with a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses on a rooftop under a spinning disco ball. The camera orbits fast. Warm sparkly sunset light.
A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses spins {moss} under her arm on a rooftop. Low angle, the camera spins with them. Warm sunset light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, holding up a slice of bread to the sunset sky. The camera cranes up. Warm golden sunset.

Neighbours laugh around a long rooftop table under warm string lights, half a giant loaf in the middle, as {moss} leans back with a contented sigh. The camera slowly drifts up and away. Warm glow against a deep blue dusk.

caption: moss burned every loaf while scrolling. phone in the Hibernator, eyes on the dough, and now the whole block eats
